options.label: Check or revise a single text

lektorat-kontext.subtitle: I work in German and English.

result-bfsg.title: Language review for BFSG-related projects
result-bfsg.text:
Since June 28, 2025, accessibility requirements have applied to certain digital products and services. I review and revise your texts so that they are clear, well structured, accessible, and easy to use. The legal classification under the BFSG remains a separate question of scope.

Reference: DARP funding guide in a Federal Ministry of Finance / PD context (accessible communication, Easy Language to BITV 2.0).

result-bitv.title: Easy Language for public authorities
result-bitv.text:
BITV 2.0 and the BGG require public authorities to communicate accessibly. I translate official notices, forms and web content into clear language, without weakening the legal substance.

Reference: DARP funding guide in a Federal Ministry of Finance / PD context.

result-leichte-sprache.title: Easy Language – voluntary, but effective
result-leichte-sprache.text: Easy Language reaches people who are shut out by standard texts: people with learning difficulties, older people, people whose first language is not German. I translate your text so that it really gets through.

result-verwaltung-behoerde.title: Clear texts for your authority
result-verwaltung-behoerde.text: Citizen-friendly language is both a political priority and a legal requirement. I revise official notices, forms and brochures so that citizens can understand them – without losing legal accuracy.

result-verwaltung-agentur.title: Language services for your public-sector contract
result-verwaltung-agentur.text: You have the contract, I deliver the language work: Easy Language, editing, translation. Reliable, on time and worded in line with BITV. 20 years' experience working with agencies and service providers.

result-verwaltung-unternehmen.title: Clear corporate communication
result-verwaltung-unternehmen.text: Whether customer letters, terms and conditions or internal guidelines: clarity saves follow-up questions and builds trust. I revise your texts so that they are clear and professional.

result-ki-einzel.title: Check and revise an AI text
result-ki-einzel.text:
AI-generated texts often sound generic, contain factual errors or do not match your company's style. I check and revise your text – for substance, language and style.

Background: quality assurance at Jung von Matt, Goodgame Studios and InnoGames.

result-ki-laufend.title: Ongoing AI quality assurance
result-ki-laufend.text:
Do you produce AI texts regularly and need someone to manage quality assurance? I handle checking, post-editing, and style-guide alignment, with reporting if you want it.

Background: quality assurance at Jung von Matt, Goodgame Studios and InnoGames.

result-lektorat-de.title: German editing
result-lektorat-de.text: Proofreading, style, consistency. I edit your texts thoroughly and reliably – from a blog post to an annual report.

result-lektorat-en.title: English editing
result-lektorat-en.text: Proofreading and editing for English texts. A strong sense of style, built through years of working in international teams across gaming, tech, and media.

result-lektorat-beide.title: Editing in German and English
result-lektorat-beide.text: Bilingual texts that have to match? I edit both versions and keep the terminology and tone consistent.

result-unsicher.title: No problem – just write to me
result-unsicher.text: Describe briefly what you need. I will get back to you within 24 hours with an assessment and a suggestion. No obligation and free of charge.
